read.thesis: Q1 CY26 beat with Operating EPS $1.50 (+33%) and FY26 guidance reaffirmed at Operating EBITDA $4.0–4.2B, but Crop Protection price fell 2% on Latin American competition, and organic growth was only 7%.

triggers.label: Crop Protection price -2% in Q1
triggers.quote: Price declined 2% due to competitive market dynamics in Latin America.

triggers.label: FY26 guidance reaffirmed, not raised
triggers.quote: The Company reaffirmed full-year 2026 guidance3 and expects Operating EBITDA1 to be in the range of $4.0 to $4.2 billion.

triggers.label: Seed price/mix up 3%
triggers.quote: Price/mix was up 3%, with gains in all regions, led by favorable product mix

triggers.label: Crop Protection volume up 6%
triggers.quote: Volume improved 6%, with gains in all regions, driven by demand for new products.

guidance.quote: expects Operating EBITDA1 to be in the range of $4.0 to $4.2 billion.
Operating EPS1 is expected to be $3.45 to $3.70 per share.
The Company plans to repurchase approximately $500 million of shares during the first half of 2026.
The Company expects to record approximately $80 million to $90 million net pre-tax restructuring charges during 2026

red_flags.label: Crop Protection price decline in Latin America
red_flags.quote: Price declined 2% due to competitive market dynamics in Latin America.
